purpose: Accounting-only reclassification of legacy P+C route for a pure runtime GPU binary instrumentation design. Not measured SLOC and not a new price.
main_doc_section: docs/llvm-gpu-sanitizer-research.md#165a-纯运行时c将预算按实际修改的软件组件重新归属历史总量不变
assumptions: Existing production LLVM GPU compiler continues building ordinary user binaries unchanged.
Runtime Binary Rewriter may reuse existing MC library read-only or implement its own decoder/encoder within UMD.
Device patch callback may be compiled by the existing compiler, which is not a compiler source modification.
All historical Compiler package effort is transferred to the UMD/Runtime Instrumentation ownership for this illustrative accounting view.
Existing KMD interface is sufficient; missing contracts are separate conditional packages.
Some legacy P budget items may be unneeded in a pure C-only design and should be audited/deducted; reclassification is not a precise minimal implementation estimate.
not_a_guarantee: This does not assert all binaries can be patched
Signed/encrypted or unsupported instruction formats may prevent runtime patching
No compilation, GPU run, repository SLOC audit or decoder feature audit performed
